notes.title: Apré Lapli 1.0.0 update
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers!

We're excited to bring you a new update packed with enhancements and fixes to make your journey even more immersive and enjoyable. Here's what's new:

Enhanced Visuals

Updated Graphics
We've reworked character models to bring more authenticity and detail to Maya, Granpa and Nyalen. 
New Visual Elements
Added new visuals scenaries to illustrate the captivating story told by Grandpa, making the narrative even more engaging.


Immersive Audio

Caribbean Songs 
Enjoy a richer auditory experience with new Caribbean songs that perfectly match the tale narrated by Grandpa, adding depth and cultural authenticity to the game.


Bug Fixes

Character Stability
Fixed issues where characters would unexpectedly go through the ground.
Interaction Improvements
Resolved multiple problems affecting character interactions to ensure smoother gameplay.
Graphical Consistency
Addressed various graphical inconsistencies to enhance visual coherence.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Discover or re-discover Apré Lapli with these exciting updates!

Happy gaming!
